criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.4-5: seven indication paragraphs with nested bullets, then a not-covered block, an imaging-guidance statement and a closing NOTE. Frequency caps are in REIMBURSEMENT INFORMATION (p.7), not the Position Statement.
procedures_covered: Plantar fasciitis and other foot neuritis
Meralgia paresthetica (lateral femoral cutaneous nerve block)

Investigational: ganglion impar, sphenopalatine, genicular, pedicle-screw/hardware blocks, any block for chronic pelvic/perineal pain, occipital/cranial blocks for headache, any block for diabetic neuropathy

logic.top_level: pathways: seven indications, each an all-of (or any-of) of symptom/failed-therapy leaves; plus a denylist

k_of_n.quote: including at least ONE of the following: Activity modification, OR Orthotics/splints/taping, OR Anti-inflammatory medications (e.g., NSAIDS)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: A denylist ('The following nerve blocks are considered experimental or investigational') and an effectiveness exclusion: 'Nerve block injections do not meet the definition of medical necessity when medical documentation indicates the injection procedures are not effective.'
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Position Statement has none; Reimbursement caps: '64400: Total number of injections is limited to four (4) injections in six (6) months' with excess 'subject to medical review'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Ischemic limb pain: Intractable pain at rest, OR Non-healing ulcers; AND Severe peripheral artery disease, AND Patient is not a candidate for revascularization, OR Previous revascularization has failed
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Mixed AND/OR at the same bullet level with only a semicolon; likely (pain OR ulcers) AND PAD AND (not candidate OR failed) but precedence is not stated.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Failed conservative treatment with ALL of the following treatments: Antidepressant OR anticonvulsant, AND Physical therapy (PT), occupational therapy (OT), or home exercise program >4 weeks
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'ALL of the following' with an OR inside item one; the >4 weeks may modify only the home exercise program, or all three.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Continued symptoms after conservative management for 3 weeks or more, including at least ONE of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'including' suggests other conservative measures may count; 'at least ONE' of the listed three is required.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Meralgia paresthetica: Lateral femoral cutaneous nerve block for meralgia paresthetica ... when symptoms continue after 4 or more weeks of conservative management (e.g., non-opioid analgesics or anticonvulsants).

It is not expected that epidural injection, facet joint injection, or sacroiliac joint injection would be administered to the same individual on the same day.
vague_terms.problem: 'not expected' is a soft rule, not a requirement.

extraction_hazards: Nested bullets in pdftotext have only '•' at two indent levels; the semantic nesting (an OR inside an AND bullet) is only visible through indent width and trailing AND/OR tokens, which are inconsistently placed ('; AND' after a bullet that closes the pair).
Indication names ('Complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS):') are plain lines ending with a colon, not styled headings; 'Pancreatic cancer:' etc. look like ordinary sentences.
Quantity limits are in Reimbursement with '**' prefix lines and a '**NOTE:' - not in the Position Statement; code ranges ('64408-64451', '64510-64530') are ranges with different limits.
The Description holds a long 'Summary and Analysis of Evidence' with case-study narrative (about 150 lines), easily mistaken for criteria language.
LOINC table at end of Reimbursement flattens 4 columns; same six-month sentence per row.
Update log (36 dated entries) contains 'E/I' abbreviation for experimental/investigational and a code history for each year.
interesting_structures: Per-indication pathways with differing conservative-therapy durations (3, 4 weeks, >1 week).
Denylist of specific nerve blocks by target and condition (e.g., genicular for chronic knee pain; any block for diabetic neuropathy).
Frequency caps by CPT range in Reimbursement with 'subject to medical review' for excess.
Imaging guidance is a separately covered add-on statement.
Policy revision history shows indications added and removed over time (e.g., 'delete criteria subsection titled all other nerve blocks').

fit_to_tree.why: each indication is an all-of with local any-of; mixed AND/OR without parentheses needs human disambiguation, and quantity limits plus conservative-therapy durations sit in different sections.
